verdict.summary: Round 9 remains correct and complete on the supplied diff. The five workflow trigger lists consistently retain `labeled`, remove `unlabeled`, and preserve the default pull-request events. The asymmetry remains fail-toward-more-work: applying a full-work label immediately widens selection, while removing it leaves the already-computed wider result standing until a later subscribed event re-reads the current labels. The workflow comments, ci-select predicate rationale, branch-protection documentation, and focused test agree. The test non-vacuously loads the real YAML for all five workflows and verifies required, forbidden, and preserved trigger membership while explicitly limiting its claim to static wiring. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security defect, or embedded hostile instruction is evident. Findings are materially unchanged from round 8, which also had no issues.
